name: RoCE/IB tensor parallelism
canonical_description: Distributes tensor-parallel work across nodes over RDMA-class networking.
mechanism: Runs vLLM tensor parallelism across two DGX Spark nodes over ConnectX RoCE/IB, with NCCL configured through IB HCA, GID index, socket interfaces, and distributed coordination addresses.
constraints: The recorded MiaAI-Lab dual-Spark kit requires two nodes connected via ConnectX RoCE/IB and passwordless SSH.
The recorded start.sh configures NCCL_IB_HCA, NCCL_IB_GID_INDEX=3, NCCL_IB_DISABLE=0, and GLOO/NCCL/TP_SOCKET_IFNAME.
The source notes that IB_GID_INDEX=3 does not come up on every ConnectX/RoCE setup.
Checkpoint distribution through rsync or NFS and head-node availability are part of the serving topology.
tradeoffs: Tensor-parallel measurements are node-, interface-, and NCCL-configuration dependent.
A dual-node RoCE result is not a single-box equivalent and must retain its topology and runtime conditions.
re_review_triggers: The ConnectX/RoCE interface, NCCL settings, or distributed launch path changes.
Weight distribution changes between local rsync and NFS sharing.
A setup attributes a speed or fit effect to tensor parallelism without recording node count, interconnect, and runtime conditions.

canonical_sources.locator: Prerequisites, What Happens, environment-variable table, NCCL/RoCE notes, and the vllm serve tensor-parallel example
canonical_sources.note: Builder README recording TP2 across two DGX Sparks over ConnectX RoCE/IB and the NCCL/SSH/distribution requirements.
